title: Harvester of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji activated his Heavenly Eye to peer into the void, he saw the crumbling fissure within Cang Yutian's pupil—the myth of immortality over ten thousand years had already begun its countdown.

text.content: The moment the illusion shattered, what surged forth from the void was not Ling Yuan's nauseatingly familiar aura, but an older, more ethereal pressure. Chen Ji's pupils constricted, his Tianji Record trembling violently as if in fear of something. 'It has come.' He spoke softly, his voice terrifyingly calm. Before him, the void twisted, and a massive eye slowly emerged across the horizon, its pupil flowing with countless threads of fate—this was the Eye of Heavenly Way.

It was not a true eye, but an illusion woven from countless karmic threads. Cang Yutian's voice emerged from the phantom, carrying the weight of ten thousand years of vicissitudes and madness: 'Chen Ji, you have finally reached this point.' His tone held a pathological joy, 'I have waited for this moment, precisely ten thousand years.' The phantom gradually solidified, transforming into an elderly figure in white robes, features blurred, yet those eyes were crystal clear, deep as an abyss.

dialogue.content: 'Ten thousand years ago, I was imprisoned at the edge of this realm, bound by fate as locks and karma as chains.' Cang Yutian's voice reverberated through the void, each word heavy with historical weight, 'But I never gave up. Generation after generation of chess players fell—you thought it was Heavenly Way's punishment? No, that was my harvest.'

text.content: Chen Ji listened silently, his expression unruffled, only his clenched fists revealing the fury within. Harvest. He had treated the common people as crops, the chess players as fertilizer. Countless brilliant talents across these millennia had been nothing but stepping stones for this person to regain freedom. 'So what?' he spoke, his voice cold as ice, 'You didn't appear today just to tell me a bedtime story, did you?'

dialogue.content: 'Ha!' Cang Yutian laughed, a hint of appreciation in his voice, 'Indeed a seed worthy of the Tianji Record's recognition.' He waved his hand, and five spheres of light materialized in the void, each containing terrifying power, 'These are the fragments of fate I collected over ten thousand years. The chess players' legacy, destiny, and talent—all sealed here.'

text.content: The five spheres of light hovered mid-air, and Chen Ji sensed familiar energies within—the residual fate trajectories of past chess players. So their deaths were not merely broken transmissions, but this person harvesting them as materials. Rage gnawed at his heart like a venomous serpent, yet his face remained as placid as still water. 'So you've come to me because you're still missing two pieces?'

dialogue.content: 'Precisely.' Cang Yutian's gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying a hunter's greed for prey, 'The Heavenly Fate power within you is the essence of the chess players' legacy. And the seventh page of the Tianji Record held by the Demonic Path commander—' he paused, his smile growing eerier, 'was originally one with your fragment. Twin fates, neither can be lacking.'

text.content: A chill ran through Chen Ji's heart. The seventh page in the Demonic Path commander's hands—he recalled that power echoing with him through the darkness, realizing it had been part of the setup from the very beginning. Cang Yutian wanted him to fuse with the Demonic Path commander, merging the two powers. 'And after the fusion?' he asked, his voice betraying no emotion, 'To become your sacrifice for reshaping Heavenly Way?'

dialogue.content: 'Sacrifice?' Cang Yutian shook his head, and even showed a hint of sincerity, 'No, you misunderstand. After the fusion, you will gain power surpassing Heavenly Way. Then, you and I together, will utterly overturn this rotten Heavenly Way.' His voice dropped low and seductive, 'Don't you want revenge? Don't you want those who trampled on you to pay the price?'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. He thought of the disdainful gazes at Tianqing Sect, of Ling Yuan's scheming behind the scenes, of countless days of humiliation as waste. Revenge—how tempting a word. But deep within his eyes, the Tianji Record fragment slowly rotated, revealing the flaws in Cang Yutian's words. 'Ten thousand years of setup, all for this moment?' He suddenly laughed, 'Senior, you are impatient.'

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's smile froze for an instant. 'What makes you say that?' Chen Ji raised his hand, the Tianji Record fragment manifesting in his palm, emanating a faint glow. 'What majesty did you possess when imprisoned ten thousand years ago?' His voice was calm yet sharp, 'But what descends today is merely a projection of consciousness. Senior—' he paused, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes, 'your time is running out, isn't it?'

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's true intentions have been revealed, and Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a blade, face this ten-thousand-year-old monster in direct combat, even if it means being crushed to dust, refusing to be a sacrifice to fate.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the self, guard the bottom line
choices.risk_hint: The opponent is a ten-thousand-year existence with unfathomable strength

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully activated the Tianji Record, golden light exploding from his body, forming a brilliant shield. 'I, Chen Ji, would rather die than be anyone's chess piece!' His voice rang through the void. Cang Yutian's face cracked for the first time, the madness suppressed for ten thousand years erupting completely—'Ungrateful wretch!'

choices.description: Pretend to be seduced, extract more information about Cang Yutian's weaknesses, secretly seek a way to break the situation.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as colluding with evil
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, prepare for counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is deeply versed in human nature and may see through the disguise

text.content: A flash of struggle crossed Chen Ji's eyes, then faded to calm. '...I need time to think.' His voice was low, weighing the pros and cons. Cang Yutian nodded with satisfaction: 'I give you three days. After three days, you must give me your answer.' He waved open a rift in the void, 'Think carefully, Chen Ji.'

choices.description: 表面上接受融合提议，实则暗中以天眼窥探仓御天的致命弱点。
choices.visible_reward: 发现关键弱点，掌握主动权
choices.risk_hint: 天眼窥探可能触发对方警觉

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, seemingly contemplating the proposal seriously. 'Fusion...' he murmured, 'could you let me see those five fragments of fate?' Cang Yutian hesitated briefly, then laughed loudly: 'You truly are a clever one!' He waved the five spheres of light before Chen Ji. Just then, Chen Ji猛地睁开双眼——天眼，启动！

Golden vertical pupils manifested at Chen Ji's brow center, the River of Fate unfolding before his eyes. He saw the past—the earth-shattering war ten thousand years ago; he saw the present—Cang Yutian's weakened true body imprisoned within some seal; and the future—upon that originally blurred thread of fate, a clearly disintegrating fissure was reflected. Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward.

dialogue.content: 'Senior, how much time remains on your seal?' Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of mockery, 'Three years? Five?' Cang Yutian's face completely darkened, the composure maintained for ten thousand years finally cracking. Chen Ji continued: 'You rush to collect fate fragments, you rush to fuse me with the Demonic Path commander—because your time is truly running out.'

text.content: Cang Yutian fell silent for a moment, the void's pressure suddenly intensifying. But Chen Ji stood unmoved, the Tianji Record's light circulating around him, deflecting that terrifying pressure. 'Ten thousand years of planning, exposed in a single moment.' Cang Yutian finally spoke, a hint of weariness in his voice, 'Chen Ji, you are more dangerous than any chess player in history.' He raised his eyes, complex emotions flickering in those deep pupils, 'But this was also within my calculations.'

Before the words even finished, the void twisted violently. Countless karmic threads surged from all directions, attempting to bind Chen Ji. This was Cang Yutian's trump card—using fate as a net, forcibly dragging Chen Ji into the fusion orbit. Chen Ji coldly snorted, the Tianji Record erupting with a brilliant column of light, severing all those karmic threads. 'Think of using fate to bind me?' His voice was ice-cold, 'Ridiculous.'

After the column of light faded, Cang Yutian's form had grown blurry. He gazed at Chen Ji, his eyes holding both anger and a trace of appreciation. 'Very good, very good indeed.' His voice drifted away, 'Since you refuse cooperation, then at the moment of fusion... I shall devour you by force.' The phantom completely vanished, leaving only Cang Yutian's final words echoing in the void: 'In three days, you will come to me of your own accord.'

The void returned to stillness, Chen Ji standing alone. His complexion was slightly pale; though the battle had been brief, it had consumed nearly twenty points of Heavenly Fate. Yet an unprecedented light gleamed in his eyes—he had found Cang Yutian's weakness. That ten-thousand-year existence, whose power was waning, was not invincible. Three days... enough time to set up his counter-move.

dialogue.content: 'Young master.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying rare solemnity, 'The seal fissure you witnessed is indeed Cang Yutian's fatal weakness. But—' he paused, 'before the seal completely collapses, he still possesses enough power to annihilate the entire cultivation world. You must be cautious.'

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, a cold smile curling his lips. 'Rest assured, Mr. Mo, I never fight battles without certainty.' He turned to gaze into the distance, toward where the Demonic Path commander was, 'Since he wants me to fuse with the Demonic Path commander, I'll show him what it means to be the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.' His figure vanished into a streak of light, disappearing into the void. And deep within his brow center, the seventh page on the Tianji Record fragment faintly flickered with a weak glow.
